items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: But -- Bud Scrippy, Arnold Bolding, did you ever hear of him?

ctx.x: Fats is in the club one night, and he saw me doing this. So he asked somebody, who is that guy?
After he heard me play. Say his name is Herman Autrey. Herman Autrey? Yeah. But -- Bud Scrippy, Arnold Bolding, did you ever hear of him?
